name: Honey Chicken with Broccoli and Rice

components.name: Honey Chicken
steps: Mix chicken with onion powder, garlic, salt and pepper; separately whisk honey, sriracha, vinegar and 7.5 ml sesame oil.
Sear chicken in 15 ml peanut oil in a wide pan until golden and fully cooked to at least 74°C.
Add honey sauce and simmer briefly until reduced to a sticky coating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Cook rinsed dry rice in measured water in a covered saucepan until fluffy.
For later-week food, freeze rice and chicken portions promptly and avoid prolonged heat on reheated broccoli.

components.name: Broccoli & Garnish
steps: In another pan, stir-fry broccoli in 7.5 ml peanut oil for 3 to 4 minutes, finishing with 5 ml sesame oil.
Portion rice, chicken and broccoli into five containers; add spring onion and sesame seeds.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Source website rice version (not earlier couscous video variation). Source ingredient lists 2 broccoli heads, fixed here as 500g trim-ready raw florets.
Storing & reheating: Creator says up to 4 days refrigerated / 3 months frozen; store broccoli separate if possible to keep texture.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.

foodSafety: Refrigerate in shallow containers promptly: within 2 hours of cooking, or within 1 hour if room temperature exceeds 32 C.
Store at 4 C or colder for no more than 3-4 days; freeze portions intended for later in the week.
Cook chicken and reheat leftovers thoroughly to 74 C. Ground pork must reach at least 71 C before serving; food-safe reheating still requires 74 C.
Rice must be rapidly cooled and chilled; never leave cooked rice standing for extended periods.
